review_method: All 45 pages of the GitHub-built PDF were visually inspected in five SHA-bound 3x3 contact sheets rendered by the successful GitHub Actions build from the committed paper.pdf. The sheets cover pages 1-45 without gaps.
review_notes: The cover, abstract, contents, section hierarchy, equations, tables, figures, appendices, and references are present and visually legible at page-layout scale.
No apparent page clipping, text overlap, truncated figure, or boundary cut-off was found in the reviewed pages.
This review concerns document layout and rendering; it is not peer review or scientific validation.
